content.title: Is Paige Bueckers Dating Azzi Fudd?
content.text: Azzi Fudd and Paige Bueckers Are Officially Dating Photo: The Hapa Blonde/GC Images Paige Bueckers is having a really good year. In April, she led the University of Connecticut women’s basketball team to victory over the South Carolina Gamecocks, clinching the 2025 NCAA championship title. One week later, she was selected as the No. 1 pick by the Dallas Wings during the WNBA draft. And now, the 23-year-old has confirmed that she’s officially off the market. In June, Bueckers’s former UConn teammate and close friend Azzi Fudd seemingly confirmed speculation that the two were dating by posting a mirror photo of her phone case, which read, “Paige Bueckers’ Girlfriend.” As expected, both women’s fans were thrilled about the revelation. Then, on Thursday, Bueckers confirmed their relationship while on the orange carpet for the first night of the WNBA’s All-Star Weekend. The Wings star played a game of “How well do you know your D1 girlfriend” with the TikTok account @wagtalk, where she correctly answered questions about Fudd’s college career, where her parents played, and the awards she’s won. At the end of the video, Bueckers was prompted to do a “girlfriend reveal,” and confirmed (with a big smile) that she had been answering questions about Fudd. Predictably, the fans in the comments were excited for official confirmation. “She cheesing mad hard too, that’s her girl fr,” one commenter wrote. “I have prayed for times like this,” shared another. The WNBA fan who runs the Gatorade account also got in on the action, writing, “We were worried for a second there.” For a long time, a Bueckers-Fudd relationship was just a theory advanced by the most eagle-eyed UConn fans. During the NCAA tournament, Bueckers and Fudd appeared inseparable, posting TikTok videos dancing in their hotel rooms and gushing over each other’s performances in interviews. While Fudd took home the Women’s Final Four’s Most Outstanding Player award, she chose to forgo the draft to play one final season with the Huskies. But Bueckers, who wound up the No. 1 pick, brought Fudd as her plus-one on draft night, kicking up rumors that things between them weren’t so platonic. Things intensified in May, when Fudd posted a TikTok video while out to lunch with Bueckers, writing: “Princess treatment every time I’m with her #spoiled.” Fudd has also been spotted at a number of Bueckers’s Wings games, including May’s face-off against the Connecticut Sun, where she wore Bueckers’s No. 5 jersey while cheering her on from the crowd. In June, Fudd sat courtside at the Wings’ game against the Washington Mystics, wearing a No. 8 Mystics jersey to support guard Georgia Amoore. Some fans apparently found the jersey switch-up disloyal, but Fudd is a collegiate basketball player set to declare for next year’s draft: Of course she’s going to have more than one friend in the league.
